text_blocks.snippet: Opsumit (macitentan) commonly causes a stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, headache, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, headache, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections

list.snippet: Severe Birth Defects: Opsumit causes major fetal harm and is strictly prohibited during pregnancy.
Liver Damage: It can cause elevated liver enzymes and liver injury. Watch for upper right stomach pain, yellowing of the skin or eyes, and dark urine.
Fluid Retention: Swelling in the hands, legs, or feet (edema) can occur, especially during the first weeks of treatment.
Anemia: Low red blood cell levels may cause unusual tiredness, weakness, or pale skin.
Reduced Sperm Count: The medication can decrease sperm production and affect male fertility.
